d: Kabhi pahaadon ki unchai, kabhi gehre canyons, toh kabhi ghane jungles! Bear Grylls ke liye wilderness mein koi bhi raasta aasaan nahi hota. Ireland ke rugged coastline se lekar Oregon ke dangerous Snake River aur Belize ke dense rainforest tak, har jagah uska saamna hota hai naye survival challenges se. Turkey aur South Dakota ke tough terrains mein bhi Bear ko apni skills, himmat aur presence of mind par bharosa karna hoga. Dekhiye kaise woh har mushkil situation ka saamna karta hai aur wilderness mein survive karne ke tareeke dikhata hai!
